record.paper_title: Boundary and Defect CFT: Open Problems and Applications
record.original_question: Can one find a closed tree-level formula for one-point functions of the closely related SO(5)-symmetric D3-D7 defect conformal field theory when the full scalar SO(6) sector is considered, beyond the already understood chiral-primary case?

evidence.quote: As regards the integrability properties of one-point functions an interesting question is whether a closed formula can be found even at tree-level for the closely related SO(5) symmetric D3-D7-brane based dCFT.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the four-dimensional defect conformal field theory obtained from N=4 super Yang–Mills theory with gauge group SU(N) by introducing a codimension-one defect dual to the probe D3–D7 brane intersection that preserves an SO(5) R-symmetry subgroup of SO(6). On one side of the defect, three of the six real scalars Φ_i (i=1,…,6) of N=4 SYM acquire classical, position-dependent vacuum expectation values built from a fuzzy-four-sphere construction with k units of background flux, while the remaining three scalars vanish classically; on the other side all scalars vanish.

Tree-level one-point functions of single-trace scalar operators of the form
   O(x) = tr( Φ_{i_1} Φ_{i_2} ⋯ Φ_{i_L} )(x)
in this background can be computed as overlaps between an SO(6) integrable spin-chain Bethe eigenstate of length L and a matrix product state |MPS_k⟩ encoding the classical defect solution.

Problem. Find a closed-form expression, valid for arbitrary chain length L, arbitrary set of magnon rapidities {u_j} solving the SO(6) Bethe equations, and arbitrary flux parameter k, for the overlap
   ⟨MPS_k | {u_j} ⟩ / ⟨{u_j} | {u_j}⟩^{1/2},
i.e. for the tree-level one-point functions of all scalar operators in the full SO(6) sector of the SO(5)-symmetric D3–D7 defect CFT, going beyond the chiral-primary (BPS) case for which a closed formula is already known.
artifact.category_tag: Defect CFT one-point functions and integrability
artifact.status_search_result: For the D3–D5 defect CFT a closed determinant formula for tree-level scalar one-point functions in the full SO(6) sector is known. For the SO(5)-symmetric D3–D7 system, partial results are available: closed expressions have been obtained for chiral primaries and for restricted SO(6) eigenstates (e.g. operators in specific subsectors), and the relevant matrix product state has been shown to satisfy integrability criteria, but a fully closed tree-level overlap formula valid for all SO(6) Bethe eigenstates and all flux parameters k does not appear to have been established in the literature.

status_evidence.title: One-Point Functions of Non-protected Operators in the SO(5) symmetric D3-D7 dCFT
status_evidence.snippet: Studies tree-level one-point functions of non-protected scalar operators in the SO(5) D3-D7 dCFT; obtains results for restricted eigenstates but not a fully closed SO(6) formula.
status_evidence.claim: Partial closed-form results for non-protected operators exist but not a complete SO(6) overlap formula.

status_evidence.title: Scalar one-point functions and matrix product states of AdS/dCFT
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses properties of the matrix product state for the SO(5) D3-D7 setup, noting that a closed expression for the overlap with Bethe eigenstates is an important open problem.
status_evidence.claim: A closed overlap formula for the D3-D7 MPS with SO(6) Bethe states was considered open.

status_evidence.title: One-point functions in AdS/dCFT (review)
status_evidence.snippet: Reviews status of D3-D5 (closed determinant formula) versus D3-D7 (only partial results) one-point functions.
status_evidence.claim: D3-D7 case lacks the full closed determinant formula known for D3-D5.
